envelope.description: Card position label, in-place update and re-post on reload

body.title: Card position label, in-place update and re-post on reload
body.summary: Add a position label to the approval card in render-registry (shown as '1 of N' when total > 1; card unchanged without position/total). Add HostToWebview {type:'approval-position', requestId, position, total} in protocol.ts and a webview branch that finds .insrc-approval[data-request-id] and rewrites its label (unknown id ignored). The host posts a card at most once per requestId while shown and posts approval-position when the queue grows. postInitialState re-posts the head card with its position after session-restored (which clears the webview transcript), so exactly one head card exists afterwards.
acceptanceChecks: A card with position/total and total > 1 shows '1 of 3'; without them it renders exactly as before
A request joining the queue while the head is shown produces an approval-position message, not a second card
approval-position for an unknown id changes nothing
On 'ready' with a queued head, the head card is posted again, after session-restored, with its position, and exactly one card for it is posted

tests.name: approval renderer: with position/total and total > 1 the card shows '1 of 3'; without them it renders exactly as before
a request joining the queue while the head is shown updates the shown card in place (one card per requestId)
reloading the webview while requests are queued re-posts the head card, and deciding it continues the queue
